name: Wyckoff Sunday Weekly Analysis
prompt:
Launch the Wyckoff weekly entry funnel in the background — it runs ~6 min, holds a singleton lock (so a retry can't duplicate it), and posts its own Telegram digest (and alerts on failure):

```bash
cd ~/.hermes/skills/wyckoff && nohup .venv/bin/python scripts/weekly.py >> logs/weekly.log 2>&1 & disown
```

The job is detached and self-reporting; do not wait for it. Respond with [SILENT].

name: Wyckoff Daily Price Alerts
prompt:
Run the Wyckoff daily price alert scan (holdings + candidates, no LLM, fires only on moves ≥3.5%):

```bash
cd ~/.hermes/skills/wyckoff && .venv/bin/python scripts/price_alerts.py >> logs/price_alerts.log 2>&1
```

If the command exits with a non-zero status, report the last 20 lines of logs/price_alerts.log to Roy. Otherwise respond with [SILENT].
